title: feat: allow four community publishers
author: gggff123
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds publisher access for @massafizidane21-ux, @vathsothary72-source, @achraf2011achraf, and @helicopterbrr.
- Keeps @connor11016 out of this change.

Closes #16142, #16111, #15833, #16264

gist.headline: Four new garden gates
gist.blurb: Four community members get publisher access. The garden has a few more people tending it.
gist.summary: The GitHub publisher access list adds @massafizidane21-ux, @vathsothary72-source, @achraf2011achraf, and @helicopterbrr.
gist.impact: These four community members gain publisher access through GitHub authentication.
gist.visual_concept: Four small publisher badges hang beside a garden gate, each marking one newly authorized community member. Polli, wearing a tiny gardener's hat, welcomes them among code-plants; no project-specific mascot is indicated.
gist.image_prompt: Polli welcomes four little publisher badges through a garden gate beside sprouting code-plants and a prominently lime green (#ecf874) path; she wears a tiny gardener's hat. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings. She is small-to-medium sized within the scene, never oversized or elongated, in strictly pixel art style. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, chunky retro sprites, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes; warm cream and lavender surroundings with dark purple (#110518) outlines, nostalgic and emotionally warm.
